summary: IF-002 company API implemented: GET/POST /api/companies, GET/PATCH/DELETE /api/companies/:id, POST :id/archive and :id/restore. Validation, repository, service and routes are separate files; server/app.ts mounts the routes. 55 API tests cover create/edit/list filters (AC-dm-09), archive/restore, and delete only for archived companies with cascade persisted (AC-dm-07).

findings.text: `pnpm test -- tests/api/companyRoutes.test.ts` (the contract command) forwards a literal `--` to vitest, so it ran the whole suite (9 files, 494 tests, exit 0) instead of only this file. The file alone (`pnpm exec vitest run tests/api/companyRoutes.test.ts`) ran 55 tests, exit 0. Both pass; the package.json script is not mine to change.

`pnpm test:e2e -- tests/e2e/companies.spec.ts` was not run: the e2e spec and the company screens belong to other units (phase-1-frontend-companies and the e2e unit) and were still being written. Not part of this unit's Done when.

messages.text: `completedCount` in the Company response counts every completed diagnosis the company owns, archived ones included (`latestStage` and `latestCompletedAt` use only the latest completed, non-archived one). With `draftId` it is the exact number a delete removes, so `countCompanyDiagnoses` in src/api/companiesApi.ts (`completedCount + (draftId ? 1 : 0)`) gives the right number for the AC-dm-07 confirmation. Screens that use `completedCount > 0` to mean 'has an active result' should keep this in mind.

Wire-level behavior the frontend can rely on: list returns a plain array sorted by name (pt-BR, case/accent-insensitive search on `q`); filters are `q`, `stage` (1..4) and `archived` (true/false/1/0, default active); optional fields come back as `null`, never missing; PATCH is a full replace with the POST schema (blank/null clears annualRevenueRange and cnpj); POST answers 201, DELETE answers 204; archive/restore are idempotent and keep the original archivedAt; validation errors are 400 validation_failed with `fields` keyed by name, segment, salesChannel, annualRevenueRange, cnpj (or `_root`) using the same pt-BR messages as CompanyFormDialog; delete of an active company is 409 company_not_archived, unknown id is 404 company_not_found.

server/app.ts now builds `createCompanyService({ prisma, now })` and mounts `createCompanyRoutes({ companies })` right after the play routes. Later units (diagnosisRoutes, historyRoutes, ...) should mount their routers next to it. To run the e2e check: `pnpm test:e2e -- tests/e2e/companies.spec.ts` once the frontend-companies and e2e units are in.
The diagnosis delete/archive units (IF-003/IF-005) should keep one draft per company (RULE-dm-13); `draftId` takes the newest draft if more than one ever exists.
